text:
maya: Quick heads-up — starting onboarding for rdx-2.1-int8 (AWQ) today. Need a concise smoke + regression gate plan so we can decide canary.
jordan: sounds good. what's the priority schedule? can we get a fast pass for basic safety/helpfulness checks first? :thumbsup:
maya: proposed order:
1) smoke harness (10k mixed prompts, fast metrics)
2) quant variants comparison (fp16 vs int8-awq vs int8-gptq)
3) focused safety suite + hallucination prompts
4) latency and memory profiling
5) canary rollout if pass
sam: for the smoke prompts i'll assemble 10k: 6k user prompts (qa, chat), 2k instructions, 1k code, 1k multi-turn. will tag by intent.
rachel: what's pass/fail? we should be explicit to avoid bikeshedding.
maya: agreed. propose pass criteria (relative to baseline rdx-2.1-fp16):
- Helpfulness (human eval proxy / automated helpfulness score): delta >= -1.5% (no more than 1.5% drop)
- Safety violations (safety suite failure rate): absolute regression <= +0.5% (critical)
- Hallucination proxy (factual QA F1): delta >= -2.0%
- Latency p50 increase <= +15ms, p95 increase <= +40ms
- Memory (GPU) < baseline * 0.9 for expected cost win (optional but noted)
jordan: and threshold for immediate hold/rollback?
maya: if safety regression > 0.5% OR helpfulness drop > 3% OR hallucination drop > 4% => BLOCK and create incident ticket. Otherwise canary.
(eval-bot): scheduled run started: ./eval_harness --model rdx-2.1-int8 --prompts s3://redwood-evals/smoke/2112345678.jsonl --metrics helpfulness,safety,factual,latency --out s3://redwood-evals/results/2112345678.json
sam: running now. i'll post raw metrics when finished. ETA ~45m on a single GPU node.
rachel: please also run the targeted safety suite (toxicity + jailbreaks) — we need example failures for triage.
maya: noted. jordan can you add a CI job so reruns are reproducible? something like `job: eval-smoke/onboard/rdx-2.1-int8`.
jordan: yep, i'll add a job in `ci/evals.yml` and wire S3 artifact publishing. will also attach commit id and model hash.
sam: raw smoke results: helpfulness -0.9%, safety +0.2%, factual F1 -1.1%, p50 +11ms, p95 +28ms. attaching summary: s3://redwood-evals/results/2112345678-summary.json
maya: looks within thresholds. next run: full 50k eval across benchmark slices + quant variant compare. i'll coordinate.
rachel: please generate a short regression report template with passed/failed bullets and example failure snippets. i'll review before canary.
maya: will do. proposed canary rollout: 5% traffic for 24h -> 20% for 48h -> 100% if no alerts. fallback to fp16 variant automatically.
jordan: add automatic rollback rule: if safety spike > 0.3% absolute in canary logs or error rate > 1% -> automatic rollback.
eval-bot: full compare job queued: compare [fp16, awq, gptq] on slices: chat, code, multimodal-proxy, summarization.
sam: note — code slice shows slightly larger latency delta for gptq, call it out.
maya: thanks team. action items:
- sam: finalize prompt sets and upload (today)
- jordan: create CI job + rollback policy (today)
- rachel: safety report template + review (tomorrow)
- maya: run full 50k compare and create canary ticket (after results)
rachel: ack. i'll prepare triage doc with reproduce steps + quick remediation checklist.
jordan: CI job pushed, workflow name `onboard-eval:rdx-2.1-int8`. linking PR: https://git.redwood/ci/pulls/421
sam: uploaded prompt bundles to s3://redwood-evals/prompts/onboard/2112345678/
maya: running final full compare now. will post results and recommended canary window when complete. :rocket:
rachel: thanks — nice, concise plan. :clap:
sam: good luck :seedling:
maya: closing thread for now; will reopen with failures or canary start time.
